title: Implement article number synthesis in SQLite per (group, server)
description:
Implement the SQLite store that assigns and records local sequential article numbers: assign_number(group: &str, cid: &Cid) -> u64 (idempotent: same CID always gets same number within a group). Implement lookup_cid(group: &str, number: u64) -> Option<Cid>. Implement group_range(group: &str) -> (low: u64, high: u64). Artifact: reader/src/store/article_numbers.rs.

Acceptance:
- Article numbers start at 1 and increment monotonically per group
- assign_number is idempotent: same (group, cid) pair always returns same number
- group_range returns correct low and high after a sequence of inserts
- SQLite migration creates the table on first run
- Unit tests cover: assign, lookup, range, idempotency, multi-group isolation
